Generated from packs/seasons/palettes.ts, packs/seasons/seasons.ts and core/tokens.ts by tools/showroom.ts — never edit showroom/index.html by hand, it is overwritten. The background here is a CSS approximation of WeatherOverlay.tsx: right for colour and feel, not a pixel match for the RN Animated original. Typefaces load from Google Fonts; offline, the page falls back to system faces and the metrics shift slightly.
